$comment: The semantic-intent fixture. It exercises every intent field the compiler reads — role (title/status/metric/meta), emphasis, surface — and NAMES NO IMPLEMENTATION ASSET: no block file, no component type, no desktop.* path, no hex, no px. The compiler picks each carrier (metric → statistic, status → refListStatus, meta → KeyInformationBar) and resolves every colour through the active theme, so the two snapshots differ by theme alone [R-042].
subtitle: Facilities  /  Assets  /  AHU-04

intent.artDirection: reads like the KPI strip on the ops dashboard

assertions.subject: uptimeMetric
assertions.description: intent.role metric compiles to a single-number tile whose value ink is the ACTIVE theme's brand role (emphasis accent)

assertions.subject: assetStatusChip
assertions.description: intent.role status compiles to the lifecycle chip carrier, never to prose [R-036]

assertions.subject: uptimeMetric
assertions.description: the metric and the status chip share the metrics row

assertions.subject: identityMeta
assertions.description: intent.role meta compiles to the at-a-glance key-information strip, one cell per bound child

assertions.subject: identityCaption
assertions.description: intent.role title compiles to heading treatment
